system.description:
• Effect: The Swashbuckler's reactive tricks — Parry, Riposte, and later additions — all draw from the same well.
  • Once per round, as a reaction, perform one Flourish Manoeuvre from those currently known.
  • Using one manoeuvre in a round means none of the others are available until the next round.
  • Known at 1st level — Parry: when struck in melee, make a Dexterity check (d20 + Dexterity modifier) against the attacker's attack roll. On success, negate the hit entirely. Cannot use while wearing medium or heavy armour or while carrying a shield

activities.name: Parry
activities.text: Against the attacker's attack roll; on success negate the hit.

activities.name: Riposte
activities.text: When an enemy misses you with a melee attack, a free attack against it as your Flourish for the round.

activities.name: Acrobatic Escape
activities.text: Against the attacker's attack roll; on success halve the damage and move up to 10ft without opportunity attacks.
